City id sapporo. Display Sapporo. Agency Sapporo City Transportation Bureau / Sapporo Municipal Subway Co., Ltd. (札幌市交通局 / 札幌市営地下鉄). Do not invent city=sms, sapporo-metro, or merge into another Hokkaido city.

City stays planned. Modes v1: Sapporo Municipal Subway only — three official lines Namboku (N), Tōzai (T), Tōhō (H). Streetcar (Sapporo City Tram), city/regional bus, and JR Hokkaido commuter/regional rail (Hakodate Main Line, Chitose Line, Gakuen-Toshi Line) are out of v1.

No official public GTFS-RT. No published next-train API. Static GTFS on HODA is dated 2020-03-24 (6+ years stale as of this pack) — confirmed empty-key 200 but NOT used to generate this file. adapterReady false. envKeys: none.

Locked hub: Odori / 大通駅 (all three lines N x T x H). Secondary two-line nodes: Sapporo (N06 x H07, no Tozai) and Susukino (Namboku N08 x Tohou H09, no Tozai) — NOTE: the roster shows the Tohou-side station is officially named 'Hosui-Susukino' (豊水すすきの), a distinct printed name from Namboku's 'Susukino' (すすきの), even though the two are the same passenger interchange precinct. Treat as two station entries with a doNotGroup-by-default posture pending official confirmation of a single combined interchange treatment, same discipline as Sapporo (Metro) vs JR Sapporo. doNotGroup Sapporo (Metro) vs JR Sapporo; Susukino vs Hosui-Susukino vs any JR co-location; Shin-Sapporo (Metro, Tozai eastern terminus) vs JR Shin-Sapporo (Chitose Line). All JR stations are separate stations connected by underground passage only — not Sapporo Municipal Subway platforms.

49 total official stations across all three lines per the oracle report's station roster (Namboku 16, Tozai 19, Tohou 14). Hub/secondary interchanges (Odori x3, Sapporo x2) collapse the unique count to 46 distinct station names — see uniqueStationCount/uniqueStations. Station codes are official (N01-N16, T01-T19, H01-H14) per the oracle report's roster table.
Direction: line + official terminus (Namboku + Makomanai). Not compass N/S/E/W, not City, not inbound/outbound. See direction-model-memo.md.
No stopIds in this file. No GTFS route ids used. Passenger line tokens are the official single letters N / T / H plus the official English line names.
